info.name: NationBuilder V2 Async Processes Path Steps API
List all path steps in a nation

params.name: include
params.description:
Comma-delimited list of sideloaded resources to include as part of the path step index response.
See guidance [here](https://support.nationbuilder.com/en/articles/9899245-api-v2-walkthrough#h_2d5333adab) about
sideloading large numbers of resources and pagination.

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Number of results to display per page (default: 20, max: 100, min: 1)

params.name: fields[path_steps]
params.description: Comma-delimited list of path step attributes to only return in the response

items.docs:
Creates a path step from given data. If the position you specify is already taken by another step on
                  the path, your step will be placed at that position and that step and the steps following will be
                  re-ordered. If you do not specify a position, the step will be auto-assigned to the last position in
                  the list of path steps for the related path.
